name: sql-migration-assessment
description: Assess a SQL database estate before migrating it: collect the SQL that defines the workload — object DDL with toolkit collect remote, script files including Teradata BTEQ with collect script, or live warehouse query history with collect history — extract table-level lineage with ds lineage, then decompose the estate into dependency-ordered, scored migration waves with migration plan. Covers SQL Server, Oracle, Teradata, Snowflake, Databricks and the other JDBC sources the toolkit parses, each by whichever collection route it supports. Produces a plan of record with an inventory, cutover constraints, and dead, audit and interface objects called out; needs no LLM and no agent license.
